name: Sunflower
ability: تولید ۵۰ خورشید هر ۲۴ ثانیه.
plantFoodEffect: تولید فوری ۱۵۰ خورشید.

almanac.description: Sunflowers are essential for you to produce extra sun. Try planting as many as you can!
almanac.plantFood: Immediately produces a large amount of sun.
almanac.flavorText: After the release of her first major Youtuber video "Zombies On Your Lawn," Sunflower's Youtuber channel has been bursting with fun. She is currently putting the final touches on her reality show TV pitch "Sunflower Thinks She Can Dance."

name: Twin Sunflower
ability: تولید ۱۰۰ خورشید در هر دور.
plantFoodEffect: تولید فوری ۲۵۰ خورشید.

almanac.description: Twin Sunflowers give twice as much sun as a normal sunflower.
almanac.plantFood: Immediately produces a large amount of sun.
almanac.flavorText: Twin Sunflower's super-chic line of ultra-expensive sunglasses has been a huge hit wherever she goes. Due to this she has been unable to travel without being swarmed by the Poppyrazzi.

name: Sun-shroom
ability: رشد در ۳ مرحله و تولید خورشید بیشتر(۲۵/۵۰/۷۵). To Stg2: 24s | To Stg3: 72s
plantFoodEffect: رشد آنی به سایز آخر و تولید ۲۲۵ خورشید.

almanac.description: Sun-shrooms give small sun at first, then normal suns, and finally large suns.
almanac.plantFood: Instantly grows to full size and produces a large amount of sun.
almanac.flavorText: Oh sure, Sun-shroom is known for his ever-present grin and sunny disposition. But truth be told, even he has his dark days. It ain't easy keeping things light when you live in the shadows.

name: Primal Sunflower
ability: تولید خورشید بزرگ ۷۵ تایی از ابتدا.
plantFoodEffect: تولید فوری ۲۲۵ خورشید.

almanac.description: Primal Sunflowers pop out large suns instead of regular ones.
almanac.plantFood: Immediately produces large amount of sun.
almanac.flavorText: Primal Sunflower is new to all this sun-giving business, so be patient with her. She's an early adopter of the all-you-can-stuff-yourself buffet style of sun production.

name: Gold Bloom
ability: تولید فوری و یک‌باره مقدار زیادی خورشید و سپس ناپدید شدن.(۳۷۵ خورشید)
plantFoodEffect: ندارد (مصرفی آنی)

almanac.description: Gold Blooms produce a burst of sun all at once.
almanac.flavorText: "Your botanists were so preoccupied with whether they could," says Gold Bloom, about nothing and to nobody in particular, "they didn't stop to think if they should."

name: Peashooter
ability: شلیک تیر مستقیم.
plantFoodEffect: شلیک رگباری سریع برای چند ثانیه.

almanac.description: Peashooters are your first line of defense. They shoot peas at attacking zombies.
almanac.plantFood: Shoots a barrage of peas.
almanac.flavorText: "What is it like being famous?" asked the Peashooter while sipping his bottled water, "I can't talk right now, I'm finishing my merchandising deal. Hold my fir coat."

name: Repeater
ability: شلیک ۲ تیر مستقیم متوالی.
plantFoodEffect: شلیک رگباری سنگین + ۱ نخود غول‌پیکر (دمیج 20 برابر).

almanac.description: Repeater fires two peas at a time.
almanac.plantFood: Shoots two volleys of peas at zombies in its row.
almanac.flavorText: "Everyone always asks me if we've met before." says Repeater. "Everyone always asks me if we've met before. Wait, did I just say that?"

name: Threepeater
ability: شلیک همزمان تیر در ۳ لاین موازی.
plantFoodEffect: شلیک رگباری بادبزنی در تمام لاین‌ها.

almanac.description: Threepeaters shoot peas in three lanes.
almanac.plantFood: Shoots a spread of peas in multiple directions, dealing damage.
almanac.flavorText: Threepeater loves playing multiplayer in video games, but split-screen never works because the left head always cheats.

name: Snow Pea
ability: شلیک تیر مستقیم کندکننده سرعت.
plantFoodEffect: انجماد لاین و شلیک رگباری یخی.

almanac.description: Snow Peas fire frozen peas making it hard for zombies to advance.
almanac.plantFood: Slows all zombies in the column , then shoots a barrage of frozen peas.
almanac.flavorText: As a professional table tennis player, in the off-season he also enjoys skiing, playing the bongos, and spelunking.

details.label: Special
details.value: Chills and damages zombie on impact

details.label: Special
details.value: Chills closely following zombies with no damage

name: Rotobaga
ability: شلیک در ۴ جهت اریب.
plantFoodEffect: شلیک رگباری در هر ۴ جهت اریب.

almanac.description: Rotobagas shoot projectiles along the four diagonals, in each direction that has a target.
almanac.plantFood: Shoots multiple huge rotobagas in four directions.
almanac.flavorText: Sometimes Rotobaga hears the plants gossiping about each other. "Did you notice so-and-so has been putting on weight?" they might say. Or "I hear that so-and-so is dating so-and-so. Can you believe it?" But Rotobaga isn't the kind of plant to engage in idle gossip. She's not interested in talking about anyone behind their leaves. She does her best to just rise above it.

name: Pea Pod
ability: شلیک تیر مستقیم به ازای هر سر کاشته شده روی هم (تا ۵ سر).
plantFoodEffect: شلیک یک نخود غول‌پیکر به ازای هر سر(دمیج 20 برابر).

almanac.description: Pea Pods can be planted in the same space for up to 5 times the destruction.
almanac.plantFood: Summons a giant Peashooter that shoots five giant peas.
almanac.flavorText: Having studied Quantum Spatial Mechanics in Clown College, Pea Pod has been amusing families of all ages.

details.label: Special
details.value: Increases rate of fire with multiple plantings

name: Split Pea
ability: شلیک ۱ تیر به جلو و ۲ تیر به عقب.
plantFoodEffect: شلیک رگباری همزمان از جلو و عقب.

almanac.description: Split Peas shoot peas forward and backwards.
almanac.plantFood: Shoots a barrage of peas at both the front and behind the plant, then fires a giant pea behind.
almanac.flavorText: "It's my turn with the eyebrows," said Frontie. "Fine, we'll split them," said Backie. Sprouted two minutes apart, their eyebrow war is eternal.

name: Citron
ability: شلیک تیر سنگین مستقیم (نیازمند زمان شارژ).
plantFoodEffect: شلیک توپ پلاسمایی پاکسازی‌کننده کل لاین.

almanac.description: Citrons shoot powerful balls of plasma.
almanac.plantFood: Shoots a giant plasma ball that can destroy most mech type zombies and flings zombies to adjacent zombies.
almanac.flavorText: As the owner and primary user of "Vitamin C-U-Later" 20-hour energy shots, Citron is always on and always ready for action. "Let's make this happen!!"

name: Bowling Bulb
ability: شلیک 3 نوع پیاز که بین لاین‌ها کمانه می‌کند (مثل wall nut bowling). تاخیر هر یک Cyan: 2s | Blue: 5s | Orange: 10s
plantFoodEffect: شلیک ۳ پیاز انفجاری بزرگ که کمانه می‌کنند.

almanac.description: Bowling Bulbs rolls shots that can bounce into multiple zombies.The Larger bulbs deal more damage.
almanac.plantFood: Shoots three charged explosive bulbs at zombies, dealing heavy damage. Waits until zombies appear on the lawn before shooting.
almanac.flavorText: Guess which team has won the League Championship for five years running now? Team Bowling Bulb, that's who. They are on a ROLL. You and your pals think you got what it takes to stop 'em? Yeah sure. Keep dreamin, bub.

name: Fire Peashooter
ability: شلیک تیر مستقیم آتشی (دمیج ۲ برابر).
plantFoodEffect: شلیک رگباری آتشین در کل لاین.

almanac.description: Fire Peashooters are immune to frost, can heat up nearby ice blocks, and shoot flaming peas down the lane.
almanac.plantFood: Creates a fire trail, unfreezing plants and damaging zombies in the row.
almanac.flavorText: Fire Peashooter knows that what she does looks exciting. But working with an open flame is serious and, more importantly, dangerous business. That's why, in her spare time, she talks to children about the importance of fire safety. "I'm a trained professional," she explains. "Don't try this at home, kids."

name: Starfruit
ability: شلیک در ۵ جهت ستاره‌ای شامل عقب.
plantFoodEffect: شلیک رگباری ستاره در تمام جهات.

almanac.description: Starfruits shoot stars in 5 directions.
almanac.plantFood: Shoots ten giant stars in five directions, dealing damage.
almanac.flavorText: Just a small town fruit that travelled to the big city and found his way to the future. His favorite modes of transportation: conveyor belts, hoverboards, and rockets. WEEEE!

name: Goo Peashooter
ability: شلیک تیر مستقیم (نادیده گرفتن زره + آسیب مستمر).
plantFoodEffect: شلیک رگباری سمی که زامبی‌ها را درجا مسموم می‌کند.

almanac.description: Goo Peashooters shoot poison peas at zombies, poisoning them as well as slowing them down.
almanac.plantFood: Summons a large ball of poison that deals damage, knock back, and poison all zombies on the lawn.
almanac.flavorText: Goo Peashooter is a goopy shooter. See? See how that works? It's a play on words. Words are often playful, folks!

name: Mega Gatling Pea
ability: شلیک ۴ تیر مستقیم متوالی با سرعت بسیار بالا.
plantFoodEffect: شلیک رگباری عظیم و طولانی در لاین به همراه 4 تیر غول‌پیکر.

almanac.description: Mega Gatling Peas fire four peas at a time, and will occasionally Plant Food itself.
almanac.plantFood: Shoots a huge number of peas out, dealing massive damage. Normal attack will fire five peas instead of four, permanently.
almanac.flavorText: "I used to be an upgrade," says Mega Gatling Pea with uncharacteristic shyness. "Now I'm my own plant, with my own ambitions, dreams and gym club memberships!"

details.label: Special
details.value: Upgrades to 5x firing speed if Plant Fooded

details.label: Special
details.value: Has chance to randomly Plant Food himself

name: Sea-shroom
ability: شلیک تیر با برد کوتاه. دارای طول عمر محدود 60 ثانیه.
plantFoodEffect: شلیک رگباری و ریست شدن طول عمر تمام Sea-shroomها.

almanac.description: Fire a short range explosive spore that will damage zombies in a radius, but it will wither away after a short time.
almanac.plantFood: Creates a clone of itself, resets the wither timer on all Sea-shroom on the gameboard, then triggers all Sea-shroom to fire a stream of spores.
almanac.flavorText: Sea-shroom and Puff-shroom are long distance cousins. No one knows when their family tree diverged, but the family reunions always involve a pool party.

details.label: Hint
details.value: Applying Plant Food to Sea-shroom will reset all Sea-shroom wither timers, as well as trigger every Sea-shroom to fire their spore stream.

name: Puff-shroom
ability: شلیک تیر با برد کوتاه. دارای طول عمر محدود 60 ثانیه.
plantFoodEffect: شلیک رگباری و ریست شدن طول عمر تمامی Puff-shroomها.

almanac.description: Puff-shrooms are short-range shooters that last for a limited time.
almanac.plantFood: All Puff-shroom on the lawn will shoot a spore barrage and reset their life duration.
almanac.flavorText: Puff-shroom is hip to all the latest social networks. He loves to surf Sporebook, FungusedIn and ShroomstaGram. But he sometimes misses the simple camaraderie of a good ol' fashioned Lawn Area Network party.

name: Caulipower
ability: شلیک تیر جادویی (جهت رندوم، عبور از موانع، هیپنوتیزم‌کننده).
plantFoodEffect: هیپنوتیزم کردن چند زامبی تصادفی در باغچه.

almanac.description: Caulipowers use their mental powers to hypnotize random zombies and turn them against their former friends.
almanac.plantFood: Tosses 5 random zombies off the lawn.
almanac.flavorText: Caulipower's eyes spin with distress. He's just thought of a really great ending for his novel, but he's afraid his cousin won't understand it.

name: Electric Blueberry
ability: شلیک رعدوبرق (جهت رندوم، نابودی کامل یک زامبی).
plantFoodEffect: نابودی کامل ۳ زامبی تصادفی.

almanac.description: Electric Blueberries randomly electrocute zombies every so often.
almanac.plantFood: Creates a storm cloud that targets 3 random zombies, dealing damage.
almanac.flavorText: Electric Blueberry prides herself for being eclectic as well as electric. "I like to keep'em guessing," she says. "A zombie should always be like, 'Whoa, didn't see that coming,' when they're disintegrated."

name: Magnet-shroom
ability: خلع سلاح؛ جذب اشیای فلزی (سطل/کلاهخود) از سر زامبی‌ها.
plantFoodEffect: جذب چندین فلز همزمان و هضم آنها

almanac.description: Magnet-shrooms remove helmets and other metal objects from zombies.
almanac.plantFood: Remove and toss all metal objects on zombies within range, dealing damage.
almanac.flavorText: Despite his unusual appearance, Magnet-shroom doesn't have a problem attracting girlfriends. But he does have a problem keeping them. It's the same thing every time. In the end, they always find him too clingy.

name: Snapdragon
ability: شلیک شعله آتش در ۶ خانه مجاور.
plantFoodEffect: آتش زدن محدوده روبروی خود.

almanac.description: Snapdragons breathe fire that causes damage in 6 adjacent tiles.
almanac.plantFood: Sets the area in front of it on fire, dealing heavy damage to zombies.
almanac.flavorText: Although the most powerful dragon in the plant kingdom, he still dreams of wings and seeing the world beneath him.

details.label: Area
details.value: Damages all zombies in the 6 tiles in front of it

name: Cactus
ability: شلیک خار مستقیم (عبور از ۳ زامبی).
plantFoodEffect: تیغ‌های برقی با دمیج بالا و نفوذ نامحدود.

almanac.description: Cactus fires a penetrating thorn that can damage multiple enemies! Hides underground when zombies are close. Can stretch up and pop balloon zombies.
almanac.plantFood: Permanently increases piercing power and damage.
almanac.flavorText: Things have really changed for Cactus lately. Book deals, movies, truck show appearances... she's just trying to focus on staying humble and launching thorns like always.

details.label: Special
details.value: Hides and does ground damage when zombies are near

details.label: Special
details.value: Pops Balloon Zombies with a special anti-balloon projectile

name: Fume-shroom
ability: شلیک دود با برد متوسط که از زامبی‌ها رد می‌شود.
plantFoodEffect: پرتاب توده دود عظیم که زامبی‌ها را به عقب می‌راند.

almanac.description: Fume-shrooms shoot fumes that damage all zombies in an area
almanac.plantFood: Sprays a stream of fumes that deal damage and pushes all zombies back.
almanac.flavorText: "I think of myself as a pretty confident shroom and an all-around fungi," says Fume-shroom. "But sometimes, when I'm eating Plant Food, I hear them chuckling. I hear them calling me 'Balloon-shroom'. I don't think they know how much that hurts."

name: Lightning Reed
ability: شلیک صاعقه که بین زامبی‌ها کمانه می‌کند.
plantFoodEffect: ایجاد ابر طوفانی و آسیب به زامبی‌ها.

almanac.description: Lightning Reeds shoot lightning at nearest zombie up to one lane away. The bolt will then arc and hit other zombies.
almanac.plantFood: Creates a storm cloud that damages random zombies on the lawn.
almanac.flavorText: This may come as a shock, but Lightning Reed has a serious passion for ham radio. His call sign is El3ctric H1ccup. You can tune in every Tuesday to hear him read the classics to elderly plants. This week: Seeds and Sensibility.

name: Cabbage-pult
ability: شلیک هوایی از روی موانع.
plantFoodEffect: پرتاب کلم به چند زامبی تصادفی.

almanac.description: Cabbage-pults hurl cabbages at the enemy.
almanac.plantFood: Launches multiple cabbages at every zombie, dealing heavy damage.
almanac.flavorText: Cabbage-pult received his doctorate in pulting from Harvest University. He knows a thing or two about launching his way to the top. He also makes a mean soup.

name: Kernel-pult
ability: شلیک دانه ذرت (آسیب کم) یا کره (توقف موقت زامبی).
plantFoodEffect: پرتاب کره به سر تمامی زامبی‌های زمین.

almanac.description: Kernel-pults fling corn kernels and immobilizing butter at zombies.
almanac.plantFood: Triggers a butter storm that stuns every zombie on the lawn for a few seconds.
almanac.flavorText: While working as an usher at the local movieplex, he saw "Fried Green Tomatoes" and found his higher calling. He packed up his husks, his kernels, his butter, and enlisted.

name: Melon-pult
ability: شلیک هوایی سنگین با آسیب مساحتی.
plantFoodEffect: پرتاب هندوانه غول‌پیکر به زامبی‌های تصادفی.

almanac.description: Melon-pults do heavy damage to groups of zombies.
almanac.plantFood: Launches melons at every zombie, dealing both damage and splash damage on impact.
almanac.flavorText: "Everyone says my head looks like a melon," said the middle child of the Pult family, "And they would be right." Don't ask him if he's seedless or not though, it offends him and frankly it's none of your business.

name: Winter Melon
ability: شلیک هوایی سنگین با آسیب مساحتی (کندکننده سرعت).
plantFoodEffect: پرتاب هندوانه یخی به زامبی‌های تصادفی.

almanac.description: Winter Melons do heavy damage and chills groups of zombies.
almanac.plantFood: Launches frozen melons at every zombie, dealing both damage and splash damage on impact.
almanac.flavorText: You may recognize Winter Melon's voice from such incredible documentaries as "It's Cold Up Here," "Ice Bingo," and "Surfin' Swedes."

name: Pepper-pult
ability: شلیک هوایی با آسیب مساحتی (گرم‌کننده محیط اطراف).
plantFoodEffect: پرتاب فلفل‌های بزرگ به ۳ زامبی تصادفی.

almanac.description: Pepper-pults lob flaming peppers at zombies and keeps nearby plants warm.
almanac.plantFood: Lobs several giant fire peppers at random zombies that deal moderate splash damage on impact.
almanac.flavorText: Some say Pepper-pult is a hot head. Some find his fiery disposition off-putting. But the truth is, he's just very focused and determined. He loves what he does. He appreciates everything he has. "I came from the weedy side of the lawn," Pepper-pult explains. "I worked hard to pull myself up by my roots. I'm a self-made pepper and I don't take a single thing for granted."

name: Potato Mine
ability: مسلح شدن با تاخیر ۱۵ ثانیه؛ انفجار هنگام تماس.
plantFoodEffect: مسلح شدن آنی و پرتاب ۲ مین کلون دیگر.

almanac.description: Potato Mines explode on contact, but they take time to arm. Plant them ahead of zombies.
almanac.plantFood: Immediately arms and spawns multiple copies of itself.
almanac.flavorText: Believe it or not, SPUDOW! did not happen overnight. Having been forced to try out new catchphrases and focus testing as many variations as possible (Tubular? Really?), Potato Mine weeded out the competition to stick with what he knows best.

name: Primal Potato Mine
ability: مسلح شدن سریع‌تر ۵ ثانیه ای و انفجار مساحتی ۳x۳.
plantFoodEffect: مسلح شدن آنی و پرتاب ۲ مین به نقاط دیگر.

almanac.description: Primal Potato Mines cost more than regular Potato Mines, but they arm more quickly and do damage over a larger area.
almanac.plantFood: Immediately arms and spawns multiple copies of itself.
almanac.flavorText: Primal Potato Mine doesn't consider himself to be primal. As far as he's concerned he's state-of-the-art. And who knows? Maybe he is.

name: Cherry Bomb
ability: انفجار فوری مساحت ۳x۳.
plantFoodEffect: ندارد (مصرفی آنی)

almanac.description: Cherry Bombs can blow up all zombies in an area. They have a short fuse so plant them near zombies.
almanac.flavorText: The Cherry Bomb Brothers attempted to start their own band. "We tried to figure out what the sound would be, but we kept explodonating speakers, stages, fans, and of course, zombies. Look for our LP next year."

name: Squash
ability: له کردن اولین زامبی مجاور.
plantFoodEffect: له کردن ۲ زامبی تصادفی در سطح زمین.

almanac.description: Squashes will smash the first zombie that gets close.
almanac.plantFood: Squashes multiple tough targets on the lawn before returning to its original location.
almanac.flavorText: Squash is actually his stage name. His birth name was Tracy.

details.label: Special
details.value: More smashes with higher plant level

name: Grapeshot
ability: انفجار مساحتی ۳x۳ و پرتاب حبه‌های کمانه‌کننده که پس از ۵ ثانیه نابود می‌شوند.
plantFoodEffect: ندارد (مصرفی آنی)

almanac.description: Grapeshots explode and scatter bouncing projectiles in eight directions.
almanac.flavorText: "Spa-BOOM!" enthuses Grapeshot. "You liked that? I got a million of 'em! Wa-POW! Buh-BLAM! Za-... um... Ker-... hmmm... Okay, I guess I've only got the three."

name: Jalapeno
ability: آتش زدن کل زامبی‌های یک لاین به صورت آنی (ذوب یخ).
plantFoodEffect: ندارد (مصرفی آنی)

almanac.description: Jalapenos destroy an entire lane of zombies.
almanac.flavorText: This jalapeno is one spicy character by day and The Macramé Vigilante by night. You might be wondering what his secret weapons is... it's knots.

name: Doom-shroom
ability: انفجار مهیب در کل باغچه و ایجاد یک گودال غیرقابل کشت.
plantFoodEffect: ندارد (مصرفی آنی)

almanac.description: Doom-shroom explodes when destroyed. Depending on the growth stage, Doom-shroom explosion radius will increase and it may even spawn additional Doom-shrooms.
almanac.plantFood: All Doom-shrooms on the lawn will grow a stage, and then explode and spawn additional Doom-shrooms.
almanac.flavorText: "Things are crazy now. Back in my day, there were Browncoats, Browncoats with cones, and Browncoats with buckets. That’s it! What are all these? Jetpacks? Magicians? Dark creatures?.. Hrmph! They better not think I am old and harmless. I may be retired but I still know a thing or two about blowing up zombies."

details.label: Hint
details.value: Doom-shrooms will leave a crater when they explode, temporarily preventing planting of new plants. Be cautious to not over trigger too many Plant foods.

name: Tangle Kelp
ability: کشیدن اولین زامبی آبی به زیر آب و نابودی آن (مخصوص ساحل).
plantFoodEffect: کشیدن چند زامبی تصادفی در آب به زیر آب.

almanac.description: Tangle Kelp are aquatic plants that pull the first zombie that nears them underwater.
almanac.plantFood: Drags up to four random zombies underwater.
almanac.flavorText: Tangle Kelp likes to go deep. He majored in philosophy. Grab a root beer with him, and he'll go on and on about Nietzsche's "Thus Spoke Zucchini" or hold forth on Kant's "Critique of Petunia Reason." It's cool and all, but sometimes you just want to keep the conversation light. Sometimes you just want to talk about the temperature of the water.

name: Iceberg Lettuce
ability: یخ زدن اولین زامبی که روی آن پا بگذارد.
plantFoodEffect: یخ زدن تمامی زامبی‌های موجود در تصویر.

almanac.description: Iceberg Lettuces freeze a zombie when stepped on.
almanac.plantFood: Freezes or chills every zombie on lawn.
almanac.flavorText: Don't get lost staring into Iceberg's adorably cute eyes. If you do, it will be your last step... but only if you're a zombie.

name: Ice-shroom
ability: یخ زدن و توقف موقت تمامی زامبی‌های موجود در کل نقشه.
plantFoodEffect: ندارد (مصرفی آنی)

almanac.description: Smashes zombies in melee range. Emits a chilling aura that both buffs nearby Winter-mint plants and chills zombies.
almanac.plantFood: Lobs several icicles at random zombies across the field.
almanac.flavorText: "It's not easy re-inventing yourself" says Ice-shroom after returning from an intensive stint of training in the coldest parts of the Antarctic. "It's not often you get a second chance, but I'm back now, and this time I won't be letting my fans or any of my friends down". Cheering erupts as Ice-shroom steps onto the lawn.

details.label: Hint
details.value: Cluster other Winter-mints plants around Ice-shroom to gain a massive damage bonus.

name: Hot Potato
ability: کاشت روی یخ برای آب کردن فوری آن (ضروری برای غار یخ‌زده).
plantFoodEffect: ندارد (مصرفی آنی)

almanac.description: Hot Potatoes melt the ice blocks they're planted on.
almanac.flavorText: How does Hot Potato stay so positive and even-peeled all the time? Yoga, that's how. She never misses a class. Also, regular meditation. It's the only way she can handle the hard work of fighting zombies, day in and day out, without melting down.

name: Grave Buster
ability: از بین بردن قبرها. (ضروری برای مراحل مصر باستان و قرون تاریک).
plantFoodEffect: ندارد (مصرفی آنی)

almanac.description: Grave Busters consume graves they're planted on.
almanac.flavorText: He may appear spiky or ill-tempered, but Grave Buster just wants to give you a big hug. Unless you're a puppy. He's terrified of those.

details.label: Usage
details.value: Single use, must be planted on graves

name: Bonk Choy
ability: ضربه فیزیکی به خانه‌های جلو و عقب.
plantFoodEffect: مشت زدن رگباری به شعاع ۳x۳ اطراف خود.

almanac.description: Bonk Choys rapidly punch nearby enemies that are ahead or behind them.
almanac.plantFood: Rapidly punches in a 3x3 around it, dealing heavy damage.
almanac.flavorText: A freelance dentist on the side, he's offering a special this month - he'll knock two of your teeth out for the price of one!

name: Phat Beet
ability: ضربه صوتی به مساحت ۳x۳ اطراف.
plantFoodEffect: ضربه صوتی بسیار قدرتمند به تمام زامبی‌های اطراف.

almanac.description: Phat Beet thumps out damage every few seconds.
almanac.plantFood: Thump the ground, dealing damage to surrounding zombies.
almanac.flavorText: Phat Beet has been known to drop sick rhymes, dope grooves, and highly satisfactory jams, often within seconds of each other.

name: Chomper
ability: بلعیدن آنی؛ نابودی یک زامبی درجا و سپس توقف برای هضم به مدت ۴۰ ثانیه.
plantFoodEffect: بلعیدن همزمان ۳ زامبی از فاصله دور.

almanac.description: Chompers can devour a zombie whole, but they are vulnerable while chewing.
almanac.plantFood: Consumes several nearby zombies in the column , then releases a burp that knocks back any survivors.
almanac.flavorText: Everyone appreciates what Chomper does. His appetite has saved them on numerous occasions. But truth be told, Chomper's friends think that eating zombies is gross. And his breath! No one has the heart to tell him, and he never gets the hint when you offer him a mint.

name: Wasabi Whip
ability: ضربه شلاق به خانه‌های جلو و عقب (گرم‌کننده محیط).
plantFoodEffect: چرخش شلاق در مساحت ۳x۳.

almanac.description: Wasabi Whips lash out with their flaming whips, delivering whippings to zombies both in front and behind.
almanac.plantFood: Spin its flaming whip around, dealing heavy damage to zombies.
almanac.flavorText: "The trick to proper whipping is all in the wrist," says Wasabi Whip. "Well, not the wrist, exactly, since I don't have any. You have to, like... BE the wrist."

details.label: Special
details.value: Resists cold and warms plants around it

name: Kiwibeast
ability: موج صوتی مساحتی؛ با گذر زمان بزرگتر شده و دمیج بیشتر می‌دهد. To Stg2: 24s | To Stg3: 72s
plantFoodEffect: پرش و کوبیدن محکم به زمین با دمیج مساحتی.

almanac.description: Kiwibeasts emit damaging thumps, and become bigger and more powerful the more they are hurt by zombies.
almanac.plantFood: Immediately grows to its last stage and deal massive damage to the surrounding area.
almanac.flavorText: "I like to keep an even keel," says Kiwibeast. "But zombies... oooh... zombies make me so mad! And when I get mad... RARRRRRGGG!"

name: Wall-nut
ability: سد دفاعی مقاوم برای متوقف کردن زامبی‌ها.
plantFoodEffect: دریافت زره دائمی به اندازه ۴۰۰۰ جان اضافه‌تر.

almanac.description: Wall-nuts have hard shells which you can use to protect your other plants.
almanac.plantFood: Heals itself and gains a hard armor shell.
almanac.flavorText: Having retired from his days as a champion bowler in the Pro Leagues, Wall-nut is looking forward to a real challenge on the front lines of home defense. DEFENSE! DEFENSE!

name: Tall-nut
ability: سد بلند؛ جلوگیری از پریدن زامبی‌ها از روی آن.
plantFoodEffect: دریافت زره دائمی ۸۰۰۰ تایی.

unlock.originalUnlock: Beating Wild West - Wild West - Day 18

almanac.description: Tall-nuts are heavy-duty wall plants that block low flying zombies.
almanac.plantFood: Heals itself and gains an extra hard armor shell.
almanac.flavorText: Tall-nut is opening a chain of stores for Tall and Taller gentlemen. "I'll shell out the savings to you!"

name: Endurian
ability: سد دفاعی با قابلیت بازتاب دمیج به زامبی مهاجم.
plantFoodEffect: دریافت زره فلزی و افزایش دمیج انعکاسی.

almanac.description: Endurians are defensive plants that deal damage to zombies attacking them.
almanac.plantFood: Heals itself and permanently gains additional armor and damage.
almanac.flavorText: "When other plants talk about me, they say I'm too gruff. They say I'm difficult to approach, that I'm afraid to let others get too close to me. Also, I smell terrible," said Endurian. But deep down inside, he knows that he's so much more than that. He's also short-tempered.

name: Garlic
ability: با خورده شدن، زامبی را مجبور به حرکت به لاین مجاور می‌کند.
plantFoodEffect: انتقال اجباری تمام زامبی‌های لاین به لاین‌های دیگر.

almanac.description: Garlic diverts zombies into other lanes.
almanac.plantFood: Heals itself and releases gas that will temporarily stun zombies in front and divert them to another column .
almanac.flavorText: Good against zombies, as well as proof against any vampires who might accidentally wander by.

name: Sweet Potato
ability: جذب‌کننده؛ زامبی‌های لاین‌های مجاور را به لاین خود می‌کشد.
plantFoodEffect: جذب تمام زامبی‌های اطراف و بازیابی کامل جان.

almanac.description: Sweet Potatoes attract zombies from other lanes when they are close by.
almanac.plantFood: Heals itself and attracts all nearby zombies to its row.
almanac.flavorText: Sweet Potato really is as sweet as she looks. Her favorite animal is the unicorn. Her favorite color is (and this is a direct quote) "all the colors in the rainbow." When she writes the letter "i", she draws a little heart where the dot belongs. Frankly, if it were anyone else, this amount of syrup would be sickening. But on her, well, it just seems right.

name: Explode-o-nut
ability: سد دفاعی که به محض از بین رفتن جانش، انفجار مساحتی ایجاد می‌کند.
plantFoodEffect: دریافت زره فلزی (هنگام نابودی زره نیز منفجر می‌شود).

almanac.description: Explode-O-Nuts provide protection, and when their shells are eaten, they explode to blow up zombies.
almanac.plantFood: Heals itself and gains an armor that will absorbs additional damage. If the armor is destroyed, unleashes a large explosion.
almanac.flavorText: "My only regret," says Explode-O-Nut, "is that I have but one chewy center full of nitroglycerin to give in defense of this lawn."

name: Pumpkin
ability: سد دفاعی پوششی؛ روی سایر گیاهان کاشته می‌شود تا از آن‌ها محافظت کند.
plantFoodEffect: دریافت زره فلزی قدرتمند.

almanac.description: Pumpkins can be planted on top of other plants to provide a tough additional layer of armor.
almanac.plantFood: Creates a hard armor shell, that can absorb additional damage.
almanac.flavorText: Pumpkin may be a hollowed-out shell, but he still has a rich inner life filled with feelings, fantasies and surprisingly disappointing opinions.

name: Sun Bean
ability: مثل دیوار دفاعی عمل می‌کند و با هر ضربه 5 خورشید تولید می‌کند.
plantFoodEffect: دریافت زره فلزی قدرتمند.

almanac.description: Sun Beans infect zombies with sun. As a zombies take damage they generate sun.
almanac.plantFood: Increases the amount of sun produces with eaten.
almanac.flavorText: As the eldest of the four bean brothers, Sun Bean often finds his siblings exasperating. Chili Bean is a little crude, Laser Bean is too far out, and Spring Bean is just plain lazy. Still, he loves them just the same. That's how it is with family.

name: Torchwood
ability: تغییر خواص تیر؛ تبدیل تیر عبوری به آتشی (دمیج دو برابر و ذوب یخ).
plantFoodEffect: ایجاد شعله آبی (دمیج تیرها را ۳ برابر می‌کند).

unlock.originalUnlock: NA: $6.99 · EU: €5.49 · UK: £4.99 Obtaining 100 seed packets

almanac.description: Torchwoods turn peas that pass through them into fireballs that deal twice as much damage. They also deal close damage as well as lanewide flame damage on defeat.
almanac.plantFood: Permanently increases the damage bonus of all the peas that pass through it.
almanac.flavorText: Torchwood and Snapdragon have become fast friends. They like to hang out at either the Tiki Lounge or the Renaissance Faire.

details.label: Special
details.value: Does lane-wide flame damage when destroyed

name: Hypno-shroom
ability: با خورده شدن، زامبی مهاجم هیپنوتیزم شده و به نفع بازیکن می‌جنگد.
plantFoodEffect: تبدیل زامبی خورنده به غول متفق (Gargantuar).

almanac.description: When zombies eat Hypno-shrooms, they will turn around and fight for you.
almanac.plantFood: Turns a hypnotized zombie into a Gargantuar.
almanac.flavorText: Hypno-shroom has no trouble persuading zombies to fight on behalf of the plants. But he has yet to convince one to cluck like a chicken. "One day," he says. "One day."

name: Imitater
ability: کپی کردن یک گیاه دیگر (امکان استفاده از دو کارت یکسان).
plantFoodEffect: ندارد (بر اساس گیاه کپی شده)

almanac.description: Imitaters let you use two of the same plant during a level!
almanac.plantFood: Performs Plant Food effect of the plant it's imitating.
almanac.flavorText: Having studied French Theater at Julienne, the Imitater went to the streets with his art, and has perfected his technique he calls "Potato stuck in a box".

name: Lily Pad
ability: بستر کاشت سایر گیاهان روی آب (ضروری برای ساحل).
plantFoodEffect: ایجاد چند کپی از خود روی خانه‌های خالی آب.

almanac.description: Lily Pads let you plant non-aquatic plants on top of them.
almanac.plantFood: Creates Lily Pads in adjacent spaces. If the adjacent space has Lily Pads- it will heal them instead.
almanac.flavorText: Not many people know this, but Lily Pad absolutely loves square dancing. There he is, a circular plant gliding across the dance floor making squares. He loves how it pushes his boundaries and really makes him think outside the sphere.

details.label: Usage
details.value: Can also be planted under non-aquatic plants

name: Enlighten-mint
ability: اعمال موقت پلنت فود به تمامی گیاهان خانواده خود
plantFoodEffect: ندارد (مصرفی آنی)

almanac.description: Enlighten-mints give a burst of sun when planted, and provide an additional temporary boost to Enlighten-mint Family plants.
almanac.plantFood: No Plant Food effect.
almanac.flavorText: Enlighten-mint wants to stress that while "enlightenment" is properly understood as "full comprehension of a situation," she herself frequently likes to ask follow-up questions just to be sure.

name: Appease-mint
ability: اعمال موقت پلنت فود به تمامی گیاهان خانواده خود
plantFoodEffect: ندارد (مصرفی آنی)

almanac.description: Appease-mints fire a volley of huge peas that break into smaller peas and provide a temporary boost to all Appease-mint Family plants on the lawn.
almanac.plantFood: No Plant Food effect.
almanac.flavorText: Appease-mint takes great umbrage at the notion that he might back down from a fight. "Yes, my name is 'Appease-mint,' but that has more to do with my affinity towards peas than any disinclination to stand up for my beliefs. Rescind your vile calumny this instant, lest I compose a blistering letter of outrage!"

name: Arma-mint
ability: اعمال موقت پلنت فود به تمامی گیاهان خانواده خود
plantFoodEffect: ندارد (مصرفی آنی)

almanac.description: Arma-mints launch a volley of heavy stunning projectiles and provide a temporary boost to all Arma-mint Family plants on the lawn.
almanac.plantFood: No Plant Food effect.
almanac.flavorText: "Lobbing projectiles, for me, has always been a very personal endeavor," says Arma-mint. "It's a great way for me to express myself, my identity, and my preference that zombies can be defeated in large groups."

name: Bombard-mint
ability: اعمال موقت پلنت فود به تمامی گیاهان خانواده خود
plantFoodEffect: ندارد (مصرفی آنی)

almanac.description: Bombard-mints set off a number of explosions on the board and provide a temporary boost to all Bombard-mint Family plants on the lawn.
almanac.plantFood: No Plant Food effect.
almanac.flavorText: "Explosions are fun," says Bombard-mint with an impish twinkle in her eye. "In the context of eliminating zombies, a cascade of detonations not only clears much of the board, but leaves a lovely fragrance in its wake. It smells like... victory."

name: Enforce-mint
ability: اعمال موقت پلنت فود به تمامی گیاهان خانواده خود
plantFoodEffect: ندارد (مصرفی آنی)

almanac.description: Enforce-mints shrink a number of zombies when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Enforce-mint Family plants on the lawn.
almanac.plantFood: No Plant Food effect.
almanac.flavorText: Enforce-mint shrinks zombies, which may seem a bit off-brand for a guy who's all about melee damage. Enforce-mint shrugs. "I don't set policy," he says.

name: Reinforce-mint
ability: اعمال موقت پلنت فود به تمامی گیاهان خانواده خود
plantFoodEffect: ندارد (مصرفی آنی)

almanac.description: Reinforce-mints push all zombies back and provide a temporary boost to all Reinforce-mint Family plants on the lawn.
almanac.plantFood: No Plant Food effect.
almanac.flavorText: Reinforce-mint isn't scowling. He's just workshopping defense strategies, doing what he can to support the team. Maybe he's scowling just a little bit. Fine.

name: Enchant-mint
ability: اعمال موقت پلنت فود به تمامی گیاهان خانواده خود
plantFoodEffect: ندارد (مصرفی آنی)

almanac.description: Enchant-mints randomly hypnotize a random number of zombies and provide a temporary boost to all Enchant-mint Family plants on the lawn.
almanac.plantFood: No Plant Food effect.
almanac.flavorText: "I just love musical theater," says Enchant-mint. Yeah, it doesn't have much to do with magic or his abilities or his strategic strengths, but it's a fact. He just likes the songs.

name: Pierce-mint
ability: اعمال موقت پلنت فود به تمامی گیاهان خانواده خود
plantFoodEffect: ندارد (مصرفی آنی)

almanac.description: Spear-mints generates a number of higher-level Spikerocks on the board and provide a temporary boost to all Spear-mint Family plants on the lawn.
almanac.plantFood: No Plant Food effect.
almanac.flavorText: "Slash!" Spear-mint enthuses. "Slishy-slashy-slice!" she adds, wanting to make sure she's getting her point across. She wants to be very clear on this.
